# Project coding standards

All Java code in this project must comply with the SE-EDU Java coding standard at https://se-education.org/guides/conventions/java/intermediate.html.

Follow the project's project-specific skill in `.github/skills/seedu-java-coding-standard/skill.md`.

Required rules:
- Use lower-case package names, PascalCase for types, camelCase for methods/fields, and SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for constants.
- Keep indentation at 4 spaces and do not use tabs.
- Keep lines at or below 120 characters; wrap long statements at sensible points.
- Write clear, English, descriptive comments and Javadoc for public classes and non-trivial public methods.
- Prefer narrow visibility, final fields where appropriate, and readable names over clever shortcuts.
- Keep the code straightforward and maintainable for a Java project used in CS2103.
